# BOSS JavaScript API Index

**Generated by `bin/boss-api` — do not edit by hand.**

Every public method, grouped by the component that defines it. Use this to
confirm a method exists **on the component you are holding** before calling it.

Several components define the same method name (`selectOption` is on
`UIListBox`, `UIPopupMenu`, `UIMenu`, and `UISearchMenu`), so grepping for a
name only proves it exists *somewhere*. Check the component's own row.

For usage patterns and HTML markup, see [`js.md`](js.md). This file is the
surface only.
